newsitem.title: GERMANY: Michael Jackson to visit German promoter in jail.
newsitem.headline: Michael Jackson to visit German promoter in jail.

text.p: U.S. pop star Michael Jackson is to visit a Munich jail to see his German concert agent, arrested earlier this month on suspicion of tax evasion, justice authorities said on Wednesday.
The justice ministry of the southern state of Bavaria said a request by Marcel Avram's agency, Mama Concerts and Rau, for Jackson to visit the promoter had been approved.

Avram, who also counts pop singers Tina Turner and Rod Stewart and opera star Jose Carreras among his friends, was arrested after a three-year investigation for evading millions of marks (dollars) in taxes.

A Mama Concerts spokeswoman said Jackson, who is scheduled to make a concert tour of Germany in May, would take part in a news conference organised by the agency in the Munich Olympic Stadium on Friday to talk about his connection with Avram and his company.

Prosecutors have not given details of the charges against Avram, but Mama Concerts said the charges were connected with the agency's links to foreign artists. Avram's lawyer has said the millionaire will do all he could to refute the charges.
Jackson is hugely popular in Germany. His appearance on a television show in 1995 made it one of the most watched programmes in German history.
